admission.justification: Code-root pairing resolution in knowledge_code_pairing and CodeTree/object_directory propagation through tree_read jointly ensure fresh and resumed knowledge_read pages evaluate real anchor currentness instead of reporting false unverifiable states.

guarantee: Converted-memory knowledge_read calls automatically pair memoryRoot to its code repository under deterministic four-tier precedence (explicit repositoryRoot, leaf contract/enclosure sibling worktree, configured repository match, workspace fallback) and propagate the resolved CodeTree and dirty working-tree object directory across fresh and resumed pages while keeping explicit continuation overrides fail-closed.
title: Automatic code-tree pairing and working-tree propagation
